name: com.draftkingsapi/server
title: DraftKings API
description: Independent DraftKings Pick6 lines/history, DFS salaries, odds, box scores. Keyless tools: no key

environmentVariables.name: DRAFTKINGS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your draftkingsapi.com API key for data tools; keyless tools work without it. Free key at https://draftkingsapi.com/sign-up

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for public search and fetch; supply Bearer followed by your API key for data tools.
